summary: Innventure, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 8, 2026, disclosing entry into an at-the-market equity offering agreement (ATM) permitting sales of up to $60 million of common stock, and discontinuation of its October 2023 standby equity purchase agreement with YA II PN, Ltd. No price per share, premium, or closing date was stated. Sales occur at the Company's discretion under parameters monitored by an independent disinterested Board committee; the registrant acts as issuer. While technically a capital-raising shelf rather than a return of capital, the ATM replacing a standby facility and disciplined capital management framing position it closest to capital structure management among the enumerated categories; it does not fit Acquisitions, Divestitures, Tender Offers, Going-Private, Spin-Offs, Rights Offerings, Restructuring, Liquidations, Delistings, Issuer Tenders, Deal Terminations, SPACs, or Management Changes. Watch dilution pace and any Form 424B5 or prospectus supplement disclosing actual sales and pricing.
